name: megalooper
description: Let Claude read what megalooper is playing and change its drums, synth, effects, grains and cutter.
long_description: megalooper is a live looper for SuperCollider that finds the meter of what you play. With this extension Claude reads the loop (its meter, uneven bars too, its tempo, and what the take played on the bar grid) the drums, the synth and the effect chains of Megalooper SA, and the grains and the cutter, and changes them when you ask: a groove that fits your 7/8, a synth line over the chords you played, a dubbier echo, an octave-down drone. You hear every change at once, and megalooper's Revert takes it back. megalooper must be running, with AI APPS switched on in its Setup view. Only this Mac is talked to; no audio leaves it.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: What megalooper is playing and how it is set: the loop's meter, its beat groups, how the take's accents fit it and its tempo, where the playhead is, what the take played, the drums, the synth, the effect chains, the grains, the cutter.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: What every setting of the drums, the synth, the effects, the grains or the cutter means.

tools.name: set_drum_pattern
tools.description: Change a drum step pattern and the kit the steps play.

tools.name: set_synth
tools.description: Change the note sequence, the Wave synth and the sequencer's switch.

tools.name: set_chain
tools.description: Add, remove, move, set and switch built-in effects.

tools.name: set_grains
tools.description: Change the granular layer's settings, its grain window and its switch.

tools.name: set_cutter
tools.description: Change the cutter's voices, its mode and its switch.

tools.name: revert
tools.description: Take back the newest change, or several.

tools.name: save_synth_preset
tools.description: Save the synth as a preset in megalooper's Synth view.

tools.name: save_sound
tools.description: Save the effect chains as a sound in megalooper's Effects view.

tools.name: save_drum_preset
tools.description: Save the drums as a preset in megalooper's Drums view.

tools.name: save_grains_preset
tools.description: Save the grains as a preset in megalooper's Grains view.

tools.name: save_cutter_preset
tools.description: Save the cutter as a preset in megalooper's Cutter view.

tools.name: list_sets
tools.description: The sets recorded before: when, each take's meter, what the players changed.

tools.name: get_set
tools.description: One recorded set in full: every take, what was played, every reading the players changed.
